title: Dataset for Identification of Homophobia and Transophobia in Multilingual YouTube Comments
reasoning: The paper performs a detailed qualitative analysis (pages 16-17) of how different religious traditions, including Christianity, Islam, and various Hindu denominations, are used in online discourse. It examines how religious texts, figures (e.g., Jesus, Adam, Eve, Iyyappan), and mythological stories are invoked in YouTube comments to either express homophobic/transphobic views or to argue in support of LGBT+ people. This constitutes a direct empirical analysis of religious and moral arguments within the collected data.
